name: Microwave Vegetable Upma
ingredients: ⅓ cup dalia (broken wheat) or whole-wheat semolina
1 cup mixed vegetables (carrot, peas, beans), diced
½ tsp each mustard seeds and urad dal
steps: Microwave the dalia in a dry bowl for 2 minutes; set aside.
In a large bowl, microwave the oil, mustard seeds, urad dal, chilli and curry leaves for 1½ minutes.
Add the onion and vegetables and microwave covered for 3 minutes.
Add the dalia, tofu, hot water and salt; cover and microwave for 5 minutes, then stand for 3 minutes.
Fluff and finish with lemon juice and coriander.
note: A speedy breakfast with extra protein from crumbled tofu.
